verses.ar: «قَدْ كَرِهَتْ نَفْسِي حَيَاتِي. أُسَيِّبُ شَكْوَايَ. أَتَكَلَّمُ فِي مَرَارَةِ نَفْسِي
verses.kjv: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.web: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.ar: قَائِلًا لِلهِ: لَا تَسْتَذْنِبْنِي. فَهِّمْنِي لِمَاذَا تُخَاصِمُنِي!
verses.kjv: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
verses.web: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

verses.ar: أَحَسَنٌ عِنْدَكَ أَنْ تَظْلِمَ، أَنْ تُرْذِلَ عَمَلَ يَدَيْكَ، وَتُشْرِقَ عَلَى مَشُورَةِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ؟
verses.kjv: [Is it] good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.web: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

verses.ar: أَلَكَ عَيْنَا بَشَرٍ، أَمْ كَنَظَرِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ تَنْظُرُ؟
verses.kjv: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
verses.web: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

verses.ar: أَأَيَّامُكَ كَأَيَّامِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ، أَمْ سِنُوكَ كَأَيَّامِ ٱلرَّجُلِ،
verses.kjv: [Are] thy days as the days of man? [are] thy years as man’s days,
verses.web: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

verses.ar: حَتَّى تَبْحَثَ عَنْ إِثْمِي وَتُفَتِّشَ عَلَى خَطِيَّتِي؟
verses.kjv: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?
verses.web: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

verses.ar: فِي عِلْمِكَ أَنِّي لَسْتُ مُذْنِبًا، وَلَا مُنْقِذَ مِنْ يَدِكَ.
verses.kjv: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and [there is] none that can deliver out of thine hand.
verses.web: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

verses.ar: «يَدَاكَ كَوَّنَتَانِي وَصَنَعَتَانِي كُلِّي جَمِيعًا، أَفَتَبْتَلِعُنِي؟
verses.kjv: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
verses.web: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

verses.ar: اُذْكُرْ أَنَّكَ جَبَلْتَنِي كَٱلطِّينِ، أَفَتُعِيدُنِي إِلَى ٱلتُّرَابِ؟
verses.kjv: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
verses.web: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَصُبَّنِي كَٱللَّبَنِ، وَخَثَّرْتَنِي كَٱلْجُبْنِ؟
verses.kjv: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.web: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

verses.ar: كَسَوْتَنِي جِلْدًا وَلَحْمًا، فَنَسَجْتَنِي بِعِظَامٍ وَعَصَبٍ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
verses.web: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

verses.ar: مَنَحْتَنِي حَيَاةً وَرَحْمَةً، وَحَفِظَتْ عِنَايَتُكَ رُوحِي.
verses.kjv: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
verses.web: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

verses.ar: لَكِنَّكَ كَتَمْتَ هَذِهِ فِي قَلْبِكَ. عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ هَذَا عِنْدَكَ:
verses.kjv: And these [things] hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this [is] with thee.
verses.web: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

verses.ar: إِنْ أَخْطَأْتُ تُلَاحِظُنِي وَلَا تُبْرِئُنِي مِنْ إِثْمِي.
verses.kjv: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
verses.web: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

verses.ar: إِنْ أَذْنَبْتُ فَوَيْلٌ لِي، وَإِنْ تَبَرَّرْتُ لَا أَرْفَعُ رَأْسِي. إِنِّي شَبْعَانُ هَوَانًا وَنَاظِرٌ مَذَلَّتِي.
verses.kjv: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and [if] I be righteous, [yet] will I not lift up my head. [I am] full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
verses.web: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

verses.ar: وَإِنِ ٱرْتَفَعْتُ تَصْطَادُنِي كَأَسَدٍ، ثُمَّ تَعُودُ وَتَتَجَبَّرُ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.web: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

verses.ar: تُجَدِّدُ شُهُودَكَ تُجَاهِي، وَتَزِيدُ غَضَبَكَ عَلَيَّ. نُوبٌ وَجَيْشٌ ضِدِّي.
verses.kjv: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war [are] against me.
verses.web: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

verses.ar: «فَلِمَاذَا أَخْرَجْتَنِي مِنَ ٱلرَّحِمِ؟ كُنْتُ قَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ ٱلرُّوحَ وَلَمْ تَرَنِي عَيْنٌ!
verses.kjv: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
verses.web: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

verses.ar: فَكُنْتُ كَأَنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ، فَأُقَادَ مِنَ ٱلرَّحِمِ إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ.
verses.kjv: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.web: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَتْ أَيَّامِي قَلِيلَةً؟ ٱتْرُكْ! كُفَّ عَنِّي فَأَتَبَلَّجَ قَلِيلًا،
verses.kjv: [Are] not my days few? cease [then, and] let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.web: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

verses.ar: قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ وَلَا أَعُودَ. إِلَى أَرْضِ ظُلْمَةٍ وَظِلِّ ٱلْمَوْتِ،
verses.kjv: Before I go [whence] I shall not return, [even] to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
verses.web: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

verses.ar: أَرْضِ ظَلَامٍ مِثْلِ دُجَى ظِلِّ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَبِلَا تَرْتِيبٍ، وَإِشْرَاقُهَا كَٱلدُّجَى».
verses.kjv: A land of darkness, as darkness [itself; and] of the shadow of death, without any order, and [where] the light [is] as darkness.
verses.web: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”
